summary: Iteration 2: Comprehensive testing of new WORK-ORDER-first workflow. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_workorder_flow.py (20 tests, ALL PASS) exercising: dashboard wo_pipeline+recent_work_orders, seeded WO/2026/001 (verified 2 items TC001 NABL K-IND [100,400] + TC002 Traceable RTD-IND [100,200]), full destructive workflow on a NEW WO (create → start-calibration BLOCKED before customer approval (400) → review → prepare-srf (verified customer name/address/items+points+cert_type prefilled from WO) → send-srf (returns token + secure link) → public GET /api/srf/{token} WITHOUT any auth cookie → public POST /api/srf/{token}/action approve → start-calibration creates one job per item with correct certificate_type propagated (NABL and Traceable) and points, WO status → calibration_in_progress → start-calibration second call blocked 400 → approve BOTH jobs → verified certificate PDFs via pypdf text extraction: NABL PDF contains 'NABL Accredited' + 'ULR', Traceable PDF contains 'Traceable Calibration' and does NOT contain 'ULR No.' → WO auto-transitions to 'completed' → public /api/verify/{vid} returns matching certificate_type). Separate WOs used for request_correction (verified lab can re-send after correction; status flips srf_correction_requested→srf_sent) and reject (status→srf_rejected). RBAC: viewer POST /api/work-orders → 403; public SRF endpoints work without any auth. Calc engine regression: CY/219.03 + CY/212.01 validation still 0 FAIL (skipped one where prior iteration stripped excel_reference — pre-existing side-effect from iteration 1). Frontend UI walk verified: Login → Dashboard shows WORK ORDER PIPELINE cards (new/srf_pending/customer_approval/ready/in_progress/correction) + Recent Work Orders table with seeded WO/2026/001 + Master Validity widget. WorkOrders list shows seeded WO. NewWorkOrder form (wo-number, wo-customer select, wo-item-points-0, wo-item-certtype-0=NABL, wo-item-template-0) submits and lands on WorkOrderDetail with stepper (Received→Lab Review→SRF Prepared→SRF Sent→Approved→Calibrating→Completed). Review Work Order + Prepare SRF + Send SRF actions all worked; secure /srf/{token} link is rendered with Copy/Open. Public SRF page (opened in a fresh incognito context with cookies cleared) rendered srf-public-card WITHOUT auth and showed srf-approve-btn / srf-correction-btn / srf-reject-btn. Overall backend+frontend flows for WO-first workflow are functional end-to-end.

minor.issue: Latent bug from iteration 1 still present: JobCreate model has no job_no field but audit() references body.job_no. Would 500 if UI calls it. Not exercised in this iteration because WO start-calibration creates jobs directly via server.py, bypassing this code path.
PointIn does not include excel_reference; any technician edit strips the seeded ground-truth. Pre-existing from iteration 1.

action_items: (Optional carry-over) Add job_no field to JobCreate model so ad-hoc POST /api/jobs works.
Consider adding backend guard so start-calibration is idempotent by returning existing job_ids instead of 400 when jobs already exist (currently 400 which is fine but slightly UX-unfriendly).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py start_calibration creates a new products row for every WO item that doesn't match name — could pollute products collection over time; consider matching on customer_id+name+serial or dedupe.
prepare_srf overwrites srf on every call; if lab edits SRF then re-clicks Prepare SRF, edits are lost. Consider a guard or explicit 'reset'.

public_srf_action allows re-approve/re-reject when status is srf_sent or srf_correction_requested but NOT after already srf_approved — good; however it allows toggling from srf_correction_requested → srf_rejected which may be desired but should be documented.
WO 'completed' transition on approve() lives inside job approval path; if a WO is manually deleted or jobs deleted, WO could get stuck. Add a maintenance recompute endpoint later.
Dashboard aggregates by loading up to 2000 jobs + 2000 work_orders in-memory; will not scale. Fine for MVP.
